criteria.commensurate: For time, yes at the sizes the map is drawn at; the refusal stays open. The reference TOTAL is +3.0% (perf-audit re-run +1.8%), and the 10 and 20 household totals fell (-8.8%, -2.9%). The cost sits on a few rolls: seed 4 15 hh +0.6 s, seed 25 15 hh +0.3 s, seed 47 40 hh +2.6 s (+20%). For privies and heaps seated where the research puts them, that is proportionate. Seed 25 at 40 hh now refuses its web, a lost map rather than a time cost, and nothing offsets it (T140, put to the GM).
criteria.necessary: Yes for the work, by control. The privy within 48 ft (0047), the heap away from the house along the privy's bearing (0042) and the barn seat withdrawn (spec-fidelity: a hamlet draws no barn) are asked for. Removing just that re-seating at f15c0d73b returns every crossing to start (seed 47 40 hh 15.7 to 13.3 s against start 13.1; seed 4 15 hh web 1.35 to 0.73 against 0.74; seed 25 10 hh homesteads 1.13 to 0.80 against 0.78). The time is the web's repair passes (drop_stranding, a second settle_the_web after straighten_joints, settle_knots) running on the new seats, plus the privy's bounded seat search.
criteria.no_way_around: Not settled by the data. The cheap fixes are in: the one-corner reach test and the bund clear's box prune (seed 4 web 4.6 to 3.7 s cProfiled, the verdicts unchanged). An incremental re-settle in place of the second full settle_the_web was measured slower in feature 297 (R12). The remaining growth is repair work that exists only because the new seats leave knots, Zs and stranded ways. The one candidate cheaper way is a seating that keeps 0042 and 0047 and leaves none, and it has not been tried (E3 row knots.py::settle_knots, T137, T140). To settle this: try that seating and time seed 47 40 hh, seed 4 15 hh and seed 25 40 hh against start, or write T137's impossibility investigation.
